card.name: Dose range after a starting number
card.fires_on: The word "to" (or the space) between two numbers in a dose range, such as "10 to 80 mg", mostly in blood pressure drug dosing text. It also fires on the space just before a dose number.

modes.label: "to" in a range
modes.description: The word "to" joining a lower dose number and an upper dose number before mg.
modes.example: The recommended dosing range is 2.5<< to>> 20 mg given twice a day

modes.label: Space before a dose number
modes.description: A blank space right before a dose figure, after a drug name or a comma in combination dosing.
